```{r infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. READ RAW SUPPLEMENTARY SOURCES DIRECTLY FROM DATA_DIR
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# INF3-01
#   NCSES Table 6-4:
#   Employed college graduates, by place of birth, level of highest degree,
#   and major occupation: 2003–23
#
# INF3-02
#   NSCG custom tabulation:
#   Relationship between field of highest degree and occupational field
#
# These are raw multi-header files, so read them without treating the first
# row as a conventional CSV header.

inf3_01 <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(
    DATA_DIR,
    "INF3-01.csv"
  ),
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_types = readr::cols(
    .default =
      readr::col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  name_repair = "minimal"
)


inf3_02 <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(
    DATA_DIR,
    "INF3-02.csv"
  ),
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_types = readr::cols(
    .default =
      readr::col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  name_repair = "minimal"
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. RAW-DATA HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_norm <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)

  x[
    is.na(x)
  ] <- ""


  normalize_label(
    x
  )
}


ch3_raw_number <- function(x) {

  x <- trimws(
    as.character(x)
  )


  # Explicit zero-style cells in the NSCG custom table.

  zero_cells <- x %in%
    c(
      "-",
      "–",
      "—"
    )


  out <- suppressWarnings(
    readr::parse_number(
      x,
      na = c(
        "",
        "NA",
        "N/A",
        "S",
        "D",
        "*"
      )
    )
  )


  out[
    zero_cells
  ] <- 0


  out
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. WEIGHTED OVERALL RATE FROM INF3-02
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# TAB301 itself contains degree-level conversion rates.
#
# For the new "Overall, average" row, return to the raw counts in INF3-02
# and calculate a true population-weighted conversion rate across:
#
#   bachelor's
#   master's
#   doctorate
#
# We use the same definition as TAB301:
#
#   denominator =
#     employed people whose highest degree field is one of the five
#     core S&E fields
#
#   numerator =
#     those people working in one of the five core S&E occupations
#
# S&E-related degree fields and S&E-related occupations are NOT included
# in this TAB301-style conversion rate.

ch3_build_overall_weighted_series <- function(raw) {

  first_column <- ch3_norm(
    raw[[1]]
  )


  year_rows <- which(
    stringr::str_detect(
      trimws(
        as.character(
          raw[[1]]
        )
      ),
      "^[0-9]{4}$"
    )
  )


  schema_rows <- which(
    first_column ==
      ch3_norm(
        "Year"
      )
  )


  if (
    length(year_rows) == 0L ||
      length(schema_rows) == 0L
  ) {

    stop(
      "Could not identify year/schema rows in INF3-02.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }


  degree_names <- c(
    "Bachelor's",
    "Master's",
    "Doctorate"
  )


  all_degree_names <- c(
    degree_names,
    "Professional"
  )


  purrr::map_dfr(

    seq_along(
      year_rows
    ),

    function(i) {

      year_row <-
        year_rows[[i]]


      year <- suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          raw[[1]][[year_row]]
        )
      )


      # Use the most recent schema/header block above this year.
      #
      # INF3-02 repeats the schema when occupational classifications change,
      # but not before every individual year.

      schema_row <- max(
        schema_rows[
          schema_rows <
            year_row
        ]
      )


      if (
        !is.finite(
          schema_row
        ) ||
          schema_row <=
            1L
      ) {

        stop(
          paste0(
            "Could not identify the degree header for INF3-02 year ",
            year,
            "."
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }


      degree_header <- ch3_norm(
        unlist(
          raw[
            schema_row - 1L,
            ,
            drop = FALSE
          ],
          use.names = FALSE
        )
      )


      occupation_header <- ch3_norm(
        unlist(
          raw[
            schema_row,
            ,
            drop = FALSE
          ],
          use.names = FALSE
        )
      )


      # Determine the rows containing the five core S&E degree fields.

      next_year_rows <- year_rows[
        year_rows >
          year_row
      ]


      candidate_end <- if (
        length(
          next_year_rows
        )
      ) {

        min(
          next_year_rows
        ) - 1L

      } else {

        nrow(raw)
      }


      candidate_rows <- seq.int(
        year_row + 1L,
        candidate_end
      )


      field_labels <- ch3_norm(
        raw[[2]][
          candidate_rows
        ]
      )


      valid_field <- nzchar(
        field_labels
      ) &

        !stringr::str_detect(
          field_labels,
          stringr::regex(
            "field of study|highest degree|occupation|labor force",
            ignore_case = TRUE
          )
        ) &

        !stringr::str_detect(
          field_labels,
          stringr::regex(
            "s&e[- ]related fields|non-s&e",
            ignore_case = TRUE
          )
        )


      field_rows <- candidate_rows[
        valid_field
      ]


      if (
        length(
          field_rows
        ) !=
          5L
      ) {

        stop(
          paste0(
            "Expected five core S&E degree-field rows in INF3-02 for ",
            year,
            "; found ",
            length(field_rows),
            "."
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }


      degree_parts <- purrr::map(

        degree_names,

        function(degree_name) {

          degree_norm <- ch3_norm(
            degree_name
          )


          # The first appearance of each degree header belongs to the
          # EMPLOYED portion of the table.

          degree_start <- which(
            degree_header ==
              degree_norm
          )[1]


          if (
            is.na(
              degree_start
            )
          ) {

            stop(
              paste0(
                "Could not find ",
                degree_name,
                " employed columns in INF3-02 for ",
                year,
                "."
              ),
              call. = FALSE
            )
          }


          all_degree_starts <- which(
            degree_header %in%
              ch3_norm(
                all_degree_names
              )
          )


          later_degree_starts <- all_degree_starts[
            all_degree_starts >
              degree_start
          ]


          degree_end <- if (
            length(
              later_degree_starts
            )
          ) {

            min(
              later_degree_starts
            ) - 1L

          } else {

            ncol(raw)
          }


          block_cols <- seq.int(
            degree_start,
            degree_end
          )


          block_occupations <-
            occupation_header[
              block_cols
            ]


          total_position <- which(
            block_occupations ==
              ch3_norm(
                "Total"
              )
          )[1]


          if (
            is.na(
              total_position
            )
          ) {

            stop(
              paste0(
                "Could not identify ",
                degree_name,
                " employed total in INF3-02 for ",
                year,
                "."
              ),
              call. = FALSE
            )
          }


          total_col <-
            block_cols[
              total_position
            ]


          # Core S&E occupations:
          #
          #   computer/math
          #   biological/life
          #   physical
          #   social
          #   engineering
          #
          # Exclude Total, S&E-related, and Non-S&E.

          se_cols <- block_cols[
            nzchar(
              block_occupations
            ) &

              block_occupations !=
                ch3_norm(
                  "Total"
                ) &

              !stringr::str_detect(
                block_occupations,
                stringr::regex(
                  "non-s&e|s&e[- ]related",
                  ignore_case = TRUE
                )
              )
          ]


          if (
            length(
              se_cols
            ) !=
              5L
          ) {

            stop(
              paste0(
                "Expected five core S&E occupation columns for ",
                degree_name,
                " in INF3-02 year ",
                year,
                "; found ",
                length(se_cols),
                "."
              ),
              call. = FALSE
            )
          }


          denominator <- sum(
            ch3_raw_number(
              unlist(
                raw[
                  field_rows,
                  total_col,
                  drop = FALSE
                ],
                use.names = FALSE
              )
            ),
            na.rm = TRUE
          )


          numerator <- sum(
            vapply(

              se_cols,

              function(j) {

                sum(
                  ch3_raw_number(
                    unlist(
                      raw[
                        field_rows,
                        j,
                        drop = FALSE
                      ],
                      use.names = FALSE
                    )
                  ),
                  na.rm = TRUE
                )
              },

              numeric(1)
            )
          )


          list(
            denominator =
              denominator,

            numerator =
              numerator
          )
        }
      )


      total_denominator <- sum(
        vapply(
          degree_parts,
          `[[`,
          numeric(1),
          "denominator"
        )
      )


      total_numerator <- sum(
        vapply(
          degree_parts,
          `[[`,
          numeric(1),
          "numerator"
        )
      )


      if (
        !is.finite(
          total_denominator
        ) ||
          total_denominator <=
            0
      ) {

        stop(
          paste0(
            "Invalid weighted denominator in INF3-02 for ",
            year,
            "."
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }


      tibble::tibble(
        Year =
          year,

        Average =
          total_numerator /
          total_denominator
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Average)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}


ch3_overall_weighted_average <-
  ch3_build_overall_weighted_series(
    inf3_02
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. WEIGHTED US-BORN / FOREIGN-BORN RATES FROM INF3-01
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# FIG304a and FIG304b come from NCSES Table 6-4.
#
# The displayed degree-level rates correspond to:
#
#   S&E occupations + S&E-related occupations
#   ------------------------------------------
#            all employed graduates
#
# The weighted average therefore sums the underlying counts across
# bachelor's + master's + doctorate BEFORE calculating the percentage.

ch3_build_birthplace_weighted_series <- function(
    raw,
    place_label
) {

  row_labels <- ch3_norm(
    raw[[1]]
  )


  # Row 3 in INF3-01 contains the years, but identify it by its label rather
  # than hard-coding a row number.

  year_header_row <- which(
    stringr::str_detect(
      as.character(
        raw[[1]]
      ),
      stringr::regex(
        "^Place.*birth",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  )[1]


  if (
    is.na(
      year_header_row
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      "Could not identify the year-header row in INF3-01.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }


  raw_years <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(
      unlist(
        raw[
          year_header_row,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ],
        use.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  )


  year_cols <- which(
    is.finite(
      raw_years
    )
  )


  years <- raw_years[
    year_cols
  ]


  if (
    length(
      year_cols
    ) <
      2L
  ) {

    stop(
      "Could not identify usable year columns in INF3-01.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }


  place_norm <- ch3_norm(
    place_label
  )


  group_start <- which(
    row_labels ==
      place_norm
  )[1]


  if (
    is.na(
      group_start
    )
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Could not find `",
        place_label,
        "` in INF3-01."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }


  place_groups <- ch3_norm(
    c(
      "All places of birth",
      "Foreign-born college graduates",
      "U.S.-born college graduates"
    )
  )


  later_groups <- which(
    seq_along(
      row_labels
    ) >
      group_start &

      row_labels %in%
        place_groups
  )


  group_end <- if (
    length(
      later_groups
    )
  ) {

    min(
      later_groups
    ) - 1L

  } else {

    nrow(raw)
  }


  degree_names <- c(
    "Bachelor's",
    "Master's",
    "Doctorate"
  )


  all_degree_names <- ch3_norm(
    c(
      degree_names,
      "Professional"
    )
  )


  degree_parts <- purrr::map(

    degree_names,

    function(degree_name) {

      degree_norm <- ch3_norm(
        degree_name
      )


      degree_row <- which(
        seq_along(
          row_labels
        ) >=
          group_start &

          seq_along(
            row_labels
          ) <=
            group_end &

          row_labels ==
            degree_norm
      )[1]


      if (
        is.na(
          degree_row
        )
      ) {

        stop(
          paste0(
            "Could not find ",
            degree_name,
            " for ",
            place_label,
            " in INF3-01."
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }


      later_degree_rows <- which(
        seq_along(
          row_labels
        ) >
          degree_row &

          seq_along(
            row_labels
          ) <=
            group_end &

          row_labels %in%
            all_degree_names
      )


      degree_end <- if (
        length(
          later_degree_rows
        )
      ) {

        min(
          later_degree_rows
        ) - 1L

      } else {

        group_end
      }


      degree_block_rows <- seq.int(
        degree_row,
        degree_end
      )


      se_row <- degree_block_rows[
        row_labels[
          degree_block_rows
        ] ==
          ch3_norm(
            "S&E occupations"
          )
      ][1]


      se_related_row <- degree_block_rows[
        row_labels[
          degree_block_rows
        ] ==
          ch3_norm(
            "S&E-related occupations"
          )
      ][1]


      if (
        is.na(
          se_row
        ) ||
          is.na(
            se_related_row
          )
      ) {

        stop(
          paste0(
            "Could not find S&E and S&E-related occupation rows for ",
            degree_name,
            ", ",
            place_label,
            " in INF3-01."
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }


      denominator <- ch3_raw_number(
        unlist(
          raw[
            degree_row,
            year_cols,
            drop = FALSE
          ],
          use.names = FALSE
        )
      )


      numerator <-
        ch3_raw_number(
          unlist(
            raw[
              se_row,
              year_cols,
              drop = FALSE
            ],
            use.names = FALSE
          )
        ) +

        ch3_raw_number(
          unlist(
            raw[
              se_related_row,
              year_cols,
              drop = FALSE
            ],
            use.names = FALSE
          )
        )


      list(
        denominator =
          denominator,

        numerator =
          numerator
      )
    }
  )


  denominator <- Reduce(
    `+`,
    lapply(
      degree_parts,
      `[[`,
      "denominator"
    )
  )


  numerator <- Reduce(
    `+`,
    lapply(
      degree_parts,
      `[[`,
      "numerator"
    )
  )


  tibble::tibble(
    Year =
      years,

    Average =
      numerator /
      denominator
  ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Average)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}


ch3_us_weighted_average <-
  ch3_build_birthplace_weighted_series(
    raw =
      inf3_01,

    place_label =
      "U.S.-born college graduates"
  )


ch3_foreign_weighted_average <-
  ch3_build_birthplace_weighted_series(
    raw =
      inf3_01,

    place_label =
      "Foreign-born college graduates"
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. OPTIONAL DATA-CONSISTENCY CHECKS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# These ensure that INF3-01 reproduces the published FIG304 degree-level
# definitions before we use it to create the new weighted averages.
#
# The raw 2003 rates should match the existing FIG304 source to within
# rounding error.

ch3_check_birthplace_rate <- function(
    raw,
    place_label,
    degree_label,
    expected_value,
    tolerance = 0.002
) {

  rows <- ch3_norm(
    raw[[1]]
  )


  place_row <- which(
    rows ==
      ch3_norm(
        place_label
      )
  )[1]


  next_place <- which(
    seq_along(rows) >
      place_row &

      rows %in%
        ch3_norm(
          c(
            "All places of birth",
            "Foreign-born college graduates",
            "U.S.-born college graduates"
          )
        )
  )


  place_end <- if (
    length(next_place)
  ) {

    min(next_place) - 1L

  } else {

    nrow(raw)
  }


  degree_row <- which(
    seq_along(rows) >=
      place_row &

      seq_along(rows) <=
        place_end &

      rows ==
        ch3_norm(
          degree_label
        )
  )[1]


  next_degree <- which(
    seq_along(rows) >
      degree_row &

      seq_along(rows) <=
        place_end &

      rows %in%
        ch3_norm(
          c(
            "Bachelor's",
            "Master's",
            "Doctorate",
            "Professional"
          )
        )
  )


  degree_end <- if (
    length(next_degree)
  ) {

    min(next_degree) - 1L

  } else {

    place_end
  }


  block_rows <- seq.int(
    degree_row,
    degree_end
  )


  se_row <- block_rows[
    rows[
      block_rows
    ] ==
      ch3_norm(
        "S&E occupations"
      )
  ][1]


  related_row <- block_rows[
    rows[
      block_rows
    ] ==
      ch3_norm(
        "S&E-related occupations"
      )
  ][1]


  # 2003 is column 2 in INF3-01.

  denominator <-
    ch3_raw_number(
      raw[[2]][[degree_row]]
    )


  numerator <-
    ch3_raw_number(
      raw[[2]][[se_row]]
    ) +
    ch3_raw_number(
      raw[[2]][[related_row]]
    )


  calculated <-
    numerator /
    denominator


  if (
    !is.finite(calculated) ||
      abs(
        calculated -
          expected_value
      ) >
        tolerance
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "INF3-01 consistency check failed for ",
        place_label,
        ", ",
        degree_label,
        "."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }


  invisible(
    TRUE
  )
}


# FIG304a 2003 bachelor's = 0.2496
ch3_check_birthplace_rate(
  inf3_01,
  "U.S.-born college graduates",
  "Bachelor's",
  0.2496
)


# FIG304b 2003 bachelor's = 0.3433
ch3_check_birthplace_rate(
  inf3_01,
  "Foreign-born college graduates",
  "Bachelor's",
  0.3433
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. SUPERSCRIPT-YEAR DISPLAY
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_superscript_year <- function(year) {

  year <- as.character(
    as.integer(year)
  )


  chartr(
    "0123456789",
    "⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹",
    year
  )
}


ch3_display_value <- function(
    value,
    value_type,
    year,
    column = c(
      "baseline",
      "latest"
    )
) {

  column <- match.arg(
    column
  )


  core <- format_value(
    value,
    value_type
  )


  expected_year <- if (
    column ==
      "baseline"
  ) {

    CH3_BASELINE_YEAR

  } else {

    CH3_TARGET_YEAR
  }


  if (
    as.integer(year) !=
      expected_year
  ) {

    paste0(
      core,
      ch3_superscript_year(
        year
      )
    )

  } else {

    core
  }
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. LONGITUDINAL ENDPOINT SELECTION
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Baseline:
#
#   1. Use 2000 if present.
#   2. Otherwise use the available observation closest to 2000.
#   3. If equally close, choose the later year.
#
# Latest:
#
#   1. Use 2025 if present.
#   2. Otherwise use the latest observation before 2025.

ch3_series_endpoints <- function(
    df,
    column,
    year_column = "Year"
) {

  series <- series_data(
    df,
    column,
    year_column
  ) %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year <=
        CH3_TARGET_YEAR
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )


  if (
    nrow(series) <
      2L
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Chapter 3 requires at least two usable observations for `",
        column,
        "`."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }


  exact_baseline <- series %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year ==
        CH3_BASELINE_YEAR
    )


  if (
    nrow(
      exact_baseline
    ) >=
      1L
  ) {

    first <- exact_baseline %>%
      slice_head(
        n = 1
      )

  } else {

    first <- series %>%
      mutate(
        Distance =
          abs(
            .data$Year -
              CH3_BASELINE_YEAR
          )
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        .data$Distance,
        desc(.data$Year)
      ) %>%
      slice_head(
        n = 1
      ) %>%
      select(
        -.data$Distance
      )
  }


  exact_latest <- series %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year ==
        CH3_TARGET_YEAR
    )


  if (
    nrow(
      exact_latest
    ) >=
      1L
  ) {

    last <- exact_latest %>%
      slice_head(
        n = 1
      )

  } else {

    last <- series %>%
      slice_tail(
        n = 1
      )
  }


  if (
    first$Year[[1]] ==
      last$Year[[1]]
  ) {

    stop(
      paste0(
        "Chapter 3 baseline and latest endpoint resolve to the same year for `",
        column,
        "`."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }


  list(
    first =
      first,

    last =
      last
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. GENERIC METRIC HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_metric_values <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    first_value,
    first_year,
    last_value,
    last_year,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {

  out <- metric_values(
    stat_id =
      stat_id,

    section_id =
      section_id,

    section =
      section,

    measure =
      measure,

    first_value =
      first_value,

    first_label =
      first_year,

    last_value =
      last_value,

    last_label =
      last_year,

    value_type =
      value_type,

    change_type =
      change_type,

    emphasis =
      emphasis
  )


  out$Earlier <- ch3_display_value(
    value =
      first_value,

    value_type =
      value_type,

    year =
      first_year,

    column =
      "baseline"
  )


  out$Latest <- ch3_display_value(
    value =
      last_value,

    value_type =
      value_type,

    year =
      last_year,

    column =
      "latest"
  )


  out
}


ch3_metric_series <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    df,
    column,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    year_column = "Year",
    emphasis = FALSE,
    transform = identity
) {

  endpoints <- ch3_series_endpoints(
    df =
      df,

    column =
      column,

    year_column =
      year_column
  )


  first_value <- transform(
    endpoints$first$Value[[1]]
  )


  last_value <- transform(
    endpoints$last$Value[[1]]
  )


  ch3_metric_values(
    stat_id =
      stat_id,

    section_id =
      section_id,

    section =
      section,

    measure =
      measure,

    first_value =
      first_value,

    first_year =
      endpoints$first$Year[[1]],

    last_value =
      last_value,

    last_year =
      endpoints$last$Year[[1]],

    value_type =
      value_type,

    change_type =
      change_type,

    emphasis =
      emphasis
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. NESTED LABELS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_nested_label <- function(x) {

  paste0(
    "\u2003\u2003",
    x
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 14. DEGREE-TO-WORK HELPERS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_degree_population_metric <- function(
    df,
    population,
    degree,
    display_degree,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {

  if (
    !degree %in%
      names(df)
  ) {

    return(
      NULL
    )
  }


  ch3_metric_series(
    stat_id =
      stat_id,

    section_id =
      "degree_work",

    section =
      "STEM Degree to STEM Job Conversion Rates",

    measure =
      ch3_nested_label(
        paste0(
          population,
          " ",
          display_degree,
          " degree holders in STEM jobs"
        )
      ),

    df =
      df,

    column =
      degree,

    value_type =
      "share",

    change_type =
      "pp_share",

    emphasis =
      emphasis
  )
}


ch3_weighted_average_metric <- function(
    df,
    stat_id,
    measure
) {

  ch3_metric_series(
    stat_id =
      stat_id,

    section_id =
      "degree_work",

    section =
      "STEM Degree to STEM Job Conversion Rates",

    measure =
      measure,

    df =
      df,

    column =
      "Average",

    value_type =
      "share",

    change_type =
      "pp_share",

    emphasis =
      TRUE
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 15. H-1B EMPLOYER SHARES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

fig305 <- fig305 %>%
  mutate(
    Company = trimws(
      as.character(
        .data$Company
      )
    )
  )


ch3_h1b_year_columns <- names(
  fig305
)[
  grepl(
    "^[0-9]{4}$",
    names(fig305)
  )
]


ch3_h1b_year_columns <- ch3_h1b_year_columns[
  as.integer(
    ch3_h1b_year_columns
  ) <=
    CH3_TARGET_YEAR
]


ch3_h1b_total <- fig305 %>%
  filter(
    normalize_label(
      .data$Company
    ) ==
      normalize_label(
        "Grand Total"
      )
  ) %>%
  select(
    all_of(
      ch3_h1b_year_columns
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to =
      "Year",
    values_to =
      "Total"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year =
      as.integer(
        .data$Year
      ),

    Total =
      numeric_clean(
        .data$Total
      )
  )


ch3_h1b_company_long <- fig305 %>%
  filter(
    normalize_label(
      .data$Company
    ) !=
      normalize_label(
        "Grand Total"
      )
  ) %>%
  select(
    .data$Company,
    all_of(
      ch3_h1b_year_columns
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -.data$Company,
    names_to =
      "Year",
    values_to =
      "Approvals"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year =
      as.integer(
        .data$Year
      ),

    Approvals = replace_na(
      numeric_clean(
        .data$Approvals
      ),
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ch3_h1b_total,
    by =
      "Year"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Share =
      .data$Approvals /
      .data$Total
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(
      .data$Share
    )
  )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Top 10 employers' combined share
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_h1b_top10 <- ch3_h1b_company_long %>%
  group_by(
    .data$Year
  ) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by =
      .data$Approvals,

    n =
      10,

    with_ties =
      FALSE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Share =
      sum(
        .data$Approvals,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) /
      first(
        .data$Total
      ),

    .groups =
      "drop"
  )

)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate 2017 -> 2025 change for every Table 3.03 firm
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_h1b_company_changes <- purrr::imap_dfr(

  CH3_H1B_TABLE303_FIRMS,

  function(
      source_company,
      display_name
  ) {

    row <- ch3_h1b_company_long %>%
      filter(
        normalize_label(
          .data$Company
        ) ==
          normalize_label(
            .env$source_company
          ),

        .data$Year %in%
          c(
            2017L,
            2025L
          )
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        .data$Year
      )


    if (
      nrow(row) !=
        2L
    ) {

      return(
        tibble::tibble()
      )
    }


    tibble::tibble(
      DisplayName =
        display_name,

      SourceCompany =
        source_company,

      FirstYear =
        row$Year[[1]],

      LastYear =
        row$Year[[2]],

      FirstShare =
        row$Share[[1]],

      LastShare =
        row$Share[[2]],

      Change =
        row$Share[[2]] -
        row$Share[[1]]
    )
  }
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two largest actual risers / two largest actual fallers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_h1b_risers <- ch3_h1b_company_changes %>%
  filter(
    .data$Change >
      0
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(.data$Change),
    .data$DisplayName
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = 2
  )


ch3_h1b_fallers <- ch3_h1b_company_changes %>%
  filter(
    .data$Change <
      0
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    .data$Change,
    .data$DisplayName
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = 2
  )


if (
  nrow(ch3_h1b_risers) <
    2L ||
    nrow(ch3_h1b_fallers) <
      2L
) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Chapter 3 requires at least two H-1B employer risers and ",
      "two fallers with usable 2017 and 2025 observations."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}


ch3_h1b_rank_metric <- function(
    row,
    stat_id,
    rank_label
) {

  ch3_metric_values(
    stat_id =
      stat_id,

    section_id =
      "h1b",

    section =
      "H-1B Employer Concentration",

    measure = paste0(
      rank_label,
      " — ",
      row$DisplayName[[1]]
    ),

    first_value =
      row$FirstShare[[1]],

    first_year =
      row$FirstYear[[1]],

    last_value =
      row$LastShare[[1]],

    last_year =
      row$LastYear[[1]],

    value_type =
      "share",

    change_type =
      "pp_share"
  )
}


ch3_h1b_rank_stats <- bind_rows(

  ),


  ch3_h1b_rank_metric(

build_ch3_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {

    c(

      "\\* FFRDCs = federally funded research and development centers.",

      paste0(
        "**Note:** Most rows compare 2000 and 2025; superscript years mark ",
        "different endpoints. Average rows are population-weighted across ",
        "bachelor’s, master’s, and doctorate levels. ", 
        "Arrow colors indicate direction of change only."
      ),

      paste0(
        "**Source:** Derived from the current report Figures and Tables: ",
        "Figures 3.01–3.06 and Tables 3.01–3.03. Additional weighted-average ",
        "calculations use the underlying NSCG custom tabulation and NCSES ",
        "Table 6-4."
      )
    )

  } else {

    character()
  }


  build_infographic_table(
    data =
      page_data,

    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),

    chapter_number =
      3,

    title =
      "FROM EDUCATION TO THE WORKFORCE: BY THE NUMBERS",

    subtitle =
      "International talent across education, research, and employment",

    column_labels = c(
      Earlier =
        "2000",

      Latest =
        "2025",

      Change =
        "Change"
    ),

    notes =
      final_notes,

    layout =
      INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,

    row_padding_px =
      INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,

    nowrap_values =
      TRUE,

    trend_right_padding_px =
      5,

    show_header =
      FALSE
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 20. EXPORT
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch3_exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
  data =
    ch3_selected,

  build_page =
    build_ch3_page,

  name =
    "infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers",

  rows_per_page =
    CH3_ROWS_PER_PAGE,

  section_headers_per_page =
    CH3_SECTION_HEADERS_PER_PAGE
)


knitr::include_graphics(
  vapply(
    ch3_exports,
    `[[`,
    character(1),
    "png_path"
  )
)
```

```{r infographic_ch4_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 2. GENERIC CHAPTER 4 HELPERS

bookend_category_metric <- function(
    df,
    id_col,
    category,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c(id_col, category) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  rows <- df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[id_col]]),
      is.finite(
        numeric_clean(
          .data[[category]]
        )
      )
    )

  if (nrow(rows) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  first <- rows %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  last <- rows %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = numeric_clean(
      first[[category]]
    )[[1]],
    first_label = as.character(
      first[[id_col]]
    )[[1]],
    last_value = numeric_clean(
      last[[category]]
    )[[1]],
    last_label = as.character(
      last[[id_col]]
    )[[1]],
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


fixed_year_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    earlier_year,
    latest_year,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c("Year", column) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$earlier_year
    )

  latest <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$latest_year
    )

  if (
    nrow(earlier) != 1 ||
    nrow(latest) != 1
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = earlier[[column]][[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = latest[[column]][[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


benchmark_text_metric <- function(
    stat_id,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    baseline_text,
    comparison_text,
    change_text,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    earlier = baseline_text,
    latest = comparison_text,
    change = change_text,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

  )

proficiency_oecd <- fig403 %>%

  ) %>%

  )


pisa_us_vs_japan <- if (
  nrow(pisa_us) == 1 &&
  nrow(pisa_japan) == 1
) {
  benchmark_text_metric(
    stat_id = "pisa_us_vs_japan",
    section_id = "performance",

    measure = "2022 PISA math score: US vs Japan",

      )

}

# 5. STEM PERSISTENCE / ATTRITION — FIGURES 4.06–4.08
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

fig407_long <- fig407 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      .data$entry_2003,
      .data$entry_2011
    ),
    names_to = "CohortCode",
    values_to = "Share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = dplyr::recode(
      .data$CohortCode,
      entry_2003 = "2003/04",
      entry_2011 = "2011/12"
    ),
    CohortOrder = dplyr::recode(
      .data$CohortCode,
      entry_2003 = 1L,
      entry_2011 = 2L
    )
  )


retention_metric <- function(
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- fig407_long %>%
    filter(
      .data$field == .env$field,
      is.finite(.data$Share)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$CohortOrder
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "persistence",
    section = "STEM persistence and attrition",
    measure = paste0(
      field,
      ": graduated in entry field"
    ),
    first_value = row$Share[[1]],
    first_label = row$Cohort[[1]],
    last_value = row$Share[[2]],
    last_label = row$Cohort[[2]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


exit_year_metric <- function(
    column,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!column %in% names(fig408)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  first <- fig408 %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  last <- fig408 %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "persistence",
    section = "STEM persistence and attrition",
    measure = measure,
    first_value = first[[column]][[1]],
    first_label = first$Cohort[[1]],
    last_value = last[[column]][[1]],
    last_label = last$Cohort[[1]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    change_type = "pp_percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


exit_first_two_years <- {
  cols <- c(
    "No degree, left without return year 1",
    "No degree, left without return year 2"
  )

  if (all(cols %in% names(fig408))) {
    first <- fig408 %>%
      slice_head(n = 1)

    last <- fig408 %>%
      slice_tail(n = 1)

    first_value <- sum(
      unlist(
        first[cols],
        use.names = FALSE
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    last_value <- sum(
      unlist(
        last[cols],
        use.names = FALSE
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    metric_values(
      stat_id = "exit_first_two_years",
      section_id = "persistence",
      section = "STEM persistence and attrition",
      measure = "STEM entrants leaving without return in first two years",
      first_value = first_value,
      first_label = first$Cohort[[1]],
      last_value = last_value,
      last_label = last$Cohort[[1]],
      value_type = "percent_value",
      change_type = "pp_percent",
      emphasis = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. INTERNATIONAL MOBILITY — FIGURES 4.09–4.10
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

mobility <- fig409 %>%
  rename(
    Country = 1
  ) %>%
  select(
    -any_of(
      "Grand Total"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -Country,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(
        .data$Year
      )
    ),
    Share = numeric_clean(
      .data$Share
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(.data$Year),
    is.finite(.data$Share)
  )


mobility_snapshot <- function(
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- mobility %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country ==
        .env$country
    ) %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = .data$Year,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_snapshot(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "mobility",
    section = "International student mobility",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      ": tertiary students studying abroad"
    ),
    value = row$Share[[1]],
    label = row$Year[[1]],
    value_type = "percent_value",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


flow_metric <- function(
    country,
    display_country = country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!country %in% names(fig410)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tmp <- fig410 %>%
    transmute(
      Year = .data$Year,
      Flow = .data[[country]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Year),
      is.finite(.data$Flow)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  first <- tmp %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  last <- tmp %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  first_m <- first$Flow[[1]] / 1e6
  last_m <- last$Flow[[1]] / 1e6
  delta_m <- last_m - first_m

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "mobility",
    section = "International student mobility",
    measure = paste0(
      display_country,
      ": net international-student flow"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      sprintf(
        "%.2fM",
        first_m
      ),
      " (",
      first$Year[[1]],
      ")"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      sprintf(
        "%.2fM",
        last_m
      ),
      " (",
      last$Year[[1]],
      ")"
    ),
    change = sprintf(
      "%+.2fM",
      delta_m
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

      CH4_SELECTED_STATS
    ),

    # Publication pagination: persistence, completion, and major switching are
    # one editorial block. Keeping study-abroad field and region as separate
    # headings gives Page 1 exactly 30 body rows + 5 visible section headers.
    Section = dplyr::case_when(
      .data$SectionID %in% c(
        "persistence",

        "switching"
      ) ~ "STEM persistence and completion",

    )

    nrow(ch4_selected),
    " rows; expected 36. Check source-column names or missing metrics."
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. BUILD PAGES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

build_ch4_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the stated earlier and latest ",
        "cohorts or years. Table 4.03 rows deliberately compare 2005 with ",
        "2024 to match the published table. Benchmark rows compare the United ",
        "States with the named OECD benchmark rather than change over time. ",
        "Arrow colors indicate numeric direction only, not whether the authors ",
        "consider the difference or change positive or negative."
      ),
      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 4.01–4.10 and ",
        "Tables 4.01–4.04. See the cited figures and tables for full source ",
        "information."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch4_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 4,
    title = "BUILDING TALENT AT HOME: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "Performance, spending, persistence, and international mobility",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest  = "Latest or<br>comparison value",
      Change  = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. EXPORT THROUGH THE GLOBAL 30-BODY-ROW / 5-HEADER PAGINATION RULE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch4_exports <- export_paginated_infographic(
  data = ch4_selected,
  build_page = build_ch4_page,
  name = "infographic_ch4_by_the_numbers"
)


knitr::include_graphics(
  vapply(
    ch4_exports,
    `[[`,
    character(1),
    "png_path"
  )
)
```

```{r infographic_ch5_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ch5_fixed_year_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    earlier_year,
    latest_year,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c("Year", column) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$earlier_year
    )

  latest <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$latest_year
    )

  if (
    nrow(earlier) != 1L ||
    nrow(latest) != 1L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = earlier[[column]][[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = latest[[column]][[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch5_slug <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_to_lower() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "[^a-z0-9]+",
      "_"
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      "^_|_$",
      ""
    )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CONFERENCE LEADERSHIP — TABLE 5.01
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table 5.01 is raw conference/country/year data. For each venue, use the first
# and last year in which both the United States and China are observed.

conference_two_country_series <- function(
    conf
) {
  tab501 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$conference) ==
        normalize_label(.env$conf),
      .data$country %in% c(
        "United States",
        "China"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      Year = .data$year,
      Country = .data$country,
      Share = .data$share
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = .data$Country,
      values_from = .data$Share
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$`United States`),
      is.finite(.data$China)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}


conference_country_metric <- function(
    conf,
    display_conf,
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  tmp <- conference_two_country_series(
    conf
  )

  if (
    nrow(tmp) < 1L ||
    !country %in% names(tmp)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "research",
    section = "Research leadership",
    measure = paste0(
      display_conf,
      ": ",
      country,
      " share of accepted author affiliations"
    ),
    first_value = tmp[[country]][[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp[[country]][[nrow(tmp)]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[nrow(tmp)]],
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

rd_type_metric <- function(
    country,
    research_type,
    display_measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    earlier_year = 1994L,
    latest_year = 2024L
) {
  tmp <- tab503 %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      .data$`Research Type` == .env$research_type,
      .data$Year %in% c(
        .env$earlier_year,
        .env$latest_year
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) != 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "rd",
    section = "R&D scale and composition",
    measure = display_measure,
    first_value = tmp$`USD, PPP conv, BN`[[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp$`USD, PPP conv, BN`[[2]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "currency_billions",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


rd_performer_metric <- function(
    country,
    category,
    display_measure,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    earlier_year = 1994L,
    latest_year = 2024L
) {
  tmp <- tab504 %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      .data$Category == .env$category,
      .data$Year %in% c(
        .env$earlier_year,
        .env$latest_year
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) != 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "rd",
    section = "R&D scale and composition",
    measure = display_measure,
    first_value = tmp$USD_PPP_BN[[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp$USD_PPP_BN[[2]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "currency_billions",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


# Construct Table 5.03 totals directly from the displayed component series.
rd_totals <- tab503 %>%
  group_by(
    .data$Year,
    .data$Country
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = sum(
      .data$`USD, PPP conv, BN`,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


rd_total_metric <- function(
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE,
    earlier_year = 1994L,
    latest_year = 2024L
) {
  tmp <- rd_totals %>%
    filter(
      .data$Country == .env$country,
      .data$Year %in% c(
        .env$earlier_year,
        .env$latest_year
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) != 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "rd",
    section = "R&D scale and composition",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      ": total R&D spending"
    ),
    first_value = tmp$Total[[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp$Total[[2]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "currency_billions",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

critical_patent_metric <- function(
    df,
    country_column,
    country_label,
    technology,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (
    !all(
      c(
        "Year",
        country_column
      ) %in% names(df)
    )
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  tmp <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year %in% c(
        2014L,
        2024L
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )

  if (nrow(tmp) != 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "critical_patents",
    section = "Patents in critical technologies",
    measure = paste0(
      country_label,
      ": ",
      technology
    ),
    first_value = tmp[[country_column]][[1]],
    first_label = tmp$Year[[1]],
    last_value = tmp[[country_column]][[2]],
    last_label = tmp$Year[[2]],
    value_type = "count",
    change_type = "percent",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

company_patent_metric <- function(

  if (is.null(stat_id)) {

  metric_values(

    last_value = row$`2025 Patents`[[1]],

    value_type = "count",
    change_type = "count_delta",

  )
}

build_ch5_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the stated first and latest ",
        "observations. R&D component and performer rows use the 1994 and 2024 ",
        "bookends shown in Tables 5.03–5.04; critical-technology patent rows ",
        "compare 2014 with 2024; corporate patent rows compare 2005 with 2025. ",
        "Arrow colors indicate numeric direction only, not whether the authors ",
        "consider the change positive or negative."
      ),
      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 5.01–5.08 and ",
        "Tables 5.01–5.06. See the cited figures and tables for full source ",
        "information."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch5_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 5,
    title = "SCIENCE, R&D, AND INNOVATION: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "Research leadership, investment, and patenting",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier<br>value",
      Latest  = "Latest<br>value",
      Change  = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}
```

```{r infographic_ch6_by_the_numbers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ch6_fixed_year_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    earlier_year,
    latest_year,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  if (!all(c("Year", column) %in% names(df))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  earlier <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$earlier_year
    )

  latest <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$latest_year
    )

  if (
    nrow(earlier) != 1L ||
    nrow(latest) != 1L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    first_value = earlier[[column]][[1]],
    first_label = earlier_year,
    last_value = latest[[column]][[1]],
    last_label = latest_year,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch6_series_metric <- function(
    df,
    column,
    section_id,
    section,
    measure,
    stat_id,
    value_type,
    change_type,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  metric_series(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = section_id,
    section = section,
    measure = measure,
    df = df,
    column = column,
    value_type = value_type,
    change_type = change_type,
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}


ch6_sum_series <- function(
    df,
    columns
) {
  row_sum_data(
    df,
    columns
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Total = .data$Value
    )
}


ch6_peak_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = .data$Value,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_first_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_head(n = 1)

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_last_endpoint <- function(
    series
) {
  row <- series %>%
    slice_tail(n = 1)

  list(
    value = row$Value[[1]],
    year = row$Year[[1]],
    label = calendar_year_label(
      row$Year[[1]]
    )
  )
}


ch6_largest_decline <- function(
    df,
    column
) {
  series <- series_data(
    df,
    column
  )

  if (nrow(series) < 2L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  candidates <- purrr::map_dfr(
    2:nrow(series),
    function(i) {
      prior <- series[
        1:(i - 1),
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      peak <- prior %>%
        slice_max(
          order_by = .data$Value,
          n = 1,
          with_ties = FALSE
        )

      tibble(
        peak_year = peak$Year[[1]],
        peak_value = peak$Value[[1]],
        trough_year = series$Year[[i]],
        trough_value = series$Value[[i]],
        decline = peak$Value[[1]] -
          series$Value[[i]]
      )
    }
  )

  best <- candidates %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = .data$decline,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    )

  list(
    peak = list(
      year = best$peak_year[[1]],
      label = calendar_year_label(
        best$peak_year[[1]]
      ),
      value = best$peak_value[[1]]
    ),
    trough = list(
      year = best$trough_year[[1]],
      label = calendar_year_label(
        best$trough_year[[1]]
      ),
      value = best$trough_value[[1]]
    )
  )
}

ch6_h1b_denial_series <- function(
    approved_df,
    denied_df
) {
  approved <- series_data(
    approved_df,
    "New Approved"
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Approved = .data$Value
    )

  denied <- series_data(
    denied_df,
    "New Denials"
  ) %>%
    rename(
      Denied = .data$Value
    )

  inner_join(
    approved,
    denied,
    by = "Year"
  ) %>%
    transmute(
      Year = .data$Year,
      Value = .data$Denied /
        (
          .data$Approved +
            .data$Denied
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Value)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}

# 7. PERMANENT-RESIDENCE BOTTLENECK — FIGURE 6.06 + TABLES 6.04–6.05
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

ch6_perm_expired_series <- function(
    country
) {
  tab604 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Country) ==
        normalize_label(.env$country),
      normalize_label(.data$Status) %in%
        c(
          normalize_label("Certified"),
          normalize_label("Certified-Expired")
        )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      StatusClean = dplyr::case_when(
        normalize_label(.data$Status) ==
          normalize_label("Certified") ~
          "Used",

        normalize_label(.data$Status) ==
          normalize_label("Certified-Expired") ~
          "Expired",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data$StatusClean)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      .data$Year,
      .data$StatusClean
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = sum(
        .data$Count,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = .data$StatusClean,
      values_from = .data$Count,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Value = .data$Expired /
        (
          .data$Used +
            .data$Expired
        )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(.data$Value)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      .data$Year
    )
}


ch6_perm_expired_metric <- function(
    country,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  series <- ch6_perm_expired_series(
    country
  )

  # Match the published Table 6.04 comparison window.
  first <- series %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == 2008L
    )

  last <- series %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == 2024L
    )

  if (
    nrow(first) != 1L ||
    nrow(last) != 1L
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_values(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "permanence",
    section = "Permanent-residence bottleneck",
    measure = paste0(
      country,
      ": PERM certifications expiring unused"
    ),
    first_value = first$Value[[1]],
    first_label = 2008L,
    last_value = last$Value[[1]],
    last_label = 2024L,
    value_type = "share",
    change_type = "pp_share",
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

ch6_wait_endpoint <- function(
    df,
    category,
    year
) {
  row <- df %>%
    filter(
      .data$Year == .env$year
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  value <- row[[category]][[1]]

  if (!is.finite(value)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  list(
    year = year,
    value = value
  )
}


ch6_wait_label <- function(
    months
) {
  months <- round(months)

  if (!is.finite(months)) {
    return("—")
  }

  if (months == 0L) {
    return("0 mo")
  }

  years <- months %/% 12
  remainder <- months %% 12

  if (years == 0L) {
    return(
      paste0(
        remainder,
        " mo"
      )
    )
  }

  if (remainder == 0L) {
    return(
      paste0(
        years,
        "y"
      )
    )
  }

  paste0(
    years,
    "y ",
    remainder,
    "m"
  )
}


ch6_wait_change_label <- function(
    first_months,
    last_months
) {
  difference <- round(
    last_months -
      first_months
  )

  if (!is.finite(difference)) {
    return("—")
  }

  sign <- if (difference > 0) {
    "+"
  } else if (difference < 0) {
    "-"
  } else {
    ""
  }

  paste0(
    sign,
    ch6_wait_label(
      abs(difference)
    )
  )
}


ch6_wait_metric <- function(
    df,
    geography,
    category,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  # Match the displayed Table 6.05: 2005 → 2025.
  first <- ch6_wait_endpoint(
    df,
    category,
    2005L
  )

  last <- ch6_wait_endpoint(
    df,
    category,
    2025L
  )

  if (
    is.null(first) ||
    is.null(last)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "permanence",
    section = "Permanent-residence bottleneck",
    measure = paste0(
      geography,
      " ",
      category,
      " green-card wait"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      ch6_wait_label(
        first$value
      ),
      " (2005)"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      ch6_wait_label(
        last$value
      ),
      " (2025)"
    ),
    change = ch6_wait_change_label(
      first$value,
      last$value
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

ch6_fig608_value <- function(
    country
) {
  value <- fig608 %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$Country) ==
        normalize_label(.env$country)
    ) %>%
    pull(
      .data$`Gap with the native-born`
    )

  if (
    length(value) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(value[[1]])
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  value[[1]]
}

ch6_loss_by_field <- fig609 %>%
  mutate(
    retained = round(
      .data$recipients *
        .data$stay_rate_10yr
    ),
    lost = .data$recipients -
      .data$retained,
    lost_share = 1 -
      .data$stay_rate_10yr
  )


ch6_total_recipients <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$recipients,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_retained <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$retained,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_lost <- sum(
  ch6_loss_by_field$lost,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

ch6_total_lost_share <- if (
  ch6_total_recipients > 0
) {
  ch6_total_lost /
    ch6_total_recipients
} else {
  NA_real_
}


ch6_loss_metric <- function(
    field,
    stat_id,
    emphasis = FALSE
) {
  row <- ch6_loss_by_field %>%
    filter(
      normalize_label(.data$field) ==
        normalize_label(.env$field)
    )

  if (nrow(row) != 1L) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  metric_text(
    stat_id = stat_id,
    section_id = "loss",
    section = "Other signals and talent loss",
    measure = paste0(
      field,
      ": US-trained international PhDs after ten years"
    ),
    earlier = paste0(
      scales::comma(
        row$recipients[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " trained (2012–14)"
    ),
    latest = paste0(
      scales::comma(
        row$retained[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " retained"
    ),
    change = paste0(
      "-",
      scales::comma(
        row$lost[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      " (",
      scales::percent(
        row$lost_share[[1]],
        accuracy = 1
      ),
      ")"
    ),
    emphasis = emphasis
  )
}

build_ch6_page <- function(
    page_data,
    page_number,
    total_pages,
    is_last_page
) {

  final_notes <- if (
    is_last_page
  ) {
    c(
      paste0(
        "**Note:** Longitudinal rows compare the stated first and latest ",
        "observations unless otherwise noted. Table 6.03 career-path rows ",
        "compare 1994 with 2024. Table 6.04 PERM-expiration rows compare ",
        "2008 with 2024. Green-card wait rows compare 2005 with 2025 to match ",
        "the published Table 6.05. Figure 6.09 uses the 2012–14 doctorate ",
        "cohorts and estimates retention from published ten-year stay rates. ",
        "Arrow colors indicate numeric direction only, not whether the authors ",
        "consider the change positive or negative."
      ),

      paste0(
        "**Source:** Current report data underlying Figures 6.01–6.09 and ",
        "Tables 6.01–6.05. See the cited figures and tables for full source ",
        "information."
      )
    )
  } else {
    character()
  }

  build_infographic_table(
    data = page_data,
    id = paste0(
      "infographic_ch6_by_the_numbers_page_",
      sprintf(
        "%02d",
        page_number
      )
    ),
    chapter_number = 6,
    title = "THE RETENTION GAP: BY THE NUMBERS",
    subtitle = "Why America is losing talent that wants to stay",
    column_labels = c(
      Earlier = "Earlier or<br>baseline",
      Latest  = "Latest or<br>outcome",
      Change  = "Change"
    ),
    notes = final_notes,
    layout = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT,
    row_padding_px = INFOGRAPHIC_FIXED_LAYOUT$row_padding_px,
    nowrap_values = TRUE
  )
}
```

# Infographic audit — Chapters 1–6

```{r infographic_source_year_audit, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}

# ============================================================================
# PUBLICATION QA: SOURCE, ENDPOINT YEAR, PAGINATION, AND CANVAS AUDIT
# CHAPTERS 1–6
#
# This audit checks the exact displayed statistics AND the exact page contract.
# It writes:
#
#   1. infographic_source_year_audit_ch1_ch6.csv
#      One row per displayed statistic.
#
#   2. infographic_page_layout_audit_ch1_ch6.csv
#      One row per exported infographic page, including body-row count,
#      section-header count, rendered-row-equivalent count, and PNG dimensions.
#
# Every NONFINAL page must be:
#      30 body rows + 5 section headers = 35 rendered row-equivalents.
#
# Final pages may be shorter but use the identical physical canvas.
# ============================================================================


audit_extract_year <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(
    x
  )

  vapply(
    x,
    function(one) {
      if (
        is.na(one) ||
        !nzchar(
          trimws(one)
        ) ||
        trimws(one) %in%
          c(
            "—",
            "–"
          )
      ) {
        return(
          NA_character_
        )
      }

      years <- stringr::str_extract_all(
        one,
        "(?<![0-9])(?:18|19|20|21)[0-9]{2}(?![0-9])"
      )[[1]]

      if (
        length(years) == 0L
      ) {
        return(
          NA_character_
        )
      }

      tail(
        years,
        1
      )
    },
    character(1)
  )
}

audit_endpoint_rule <- function(
    chapter,
    stat_id
) {
  dplyr::case_when(

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 1
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 1" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "tab101_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit TAB101 2015 → 2025 columns",

    chapter == "Chapter 1" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "proj_"
      ) ~
      "Latest observed year → latest projected year",

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 2
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "enrollment_"
      ) ~
      "2025 actual count + FIG206 year-over-year change → 2026P",

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "top_recruitment_"
      ) ~
      "2015 historical recruitment baseline → 2025 FIG207 priority",

    chapter == "Chapter 2" &
      stat_id %in%
        c(
          "visa_application_process",
          "travel_restrictions",
          "feeling_unwelcome",
          "social_political_environment"
        ) ~
      "Earliest available survey observation → Fall 2025",

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 3
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "h1b_"
      ) ~
      "2017 → 2025",

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "founder_origin_"
      ) ~
      "2025 founder-origin snapshot",

    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "ai_staffing_"
      ) ~
      "Snapshot composition: US / China / rest of world; not a time comparison",

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 4
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stat_id %in%
        c(
          "pisa_us_vs_japan",
          "pisa_top_math_us_vs_oecd"
        ) ~
      "2022 PISA benchmark comparison; not a time comparison",

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "spending_"
      ) ~
      "OECD spending benchmark comparison; not a time comparison",

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "study_field_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit Table 4.03 comparison: 2005 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "study_region_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit Table 4.04 comparison: 2005 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 4" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "outbound_"
      ) ~
      "Latest available outbound-mobility snapshot",

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 5
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 5" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "conference_"
      ) ~
      "First and latest years with both US and China observed at the venue",

    chapter == "Chapter 5" &
      stat_id %in%
        c(
          "rd_total_us",
          "rd_total_china",
          "rd_basic_us",
          "rd_basic_china",
          "rd_experimental_us",
          "rd_experimental_china",
          "rd_business_us",
          "rd_business_china"
        ) ~
      "Explicit R&D comparison: 1994 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 5" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "patent_biotech_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit biotechnology-patent comparison: 2014 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 5" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "patent_semiconductor_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit semiconductor-patent comparison: 2014 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 5" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "patent_computer_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit computer-technology-patent comparison: 2014 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 5" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "company_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit corporate US-patent comparison: 2005 → 2025",

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Chapter 6
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    chapter == "Chapter 6" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "career_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit Table 6.03 comparison: 1994 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 6" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "perm_expired_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit Table 6.04 comparison: 2008 → 2024",

    chapter == "Chapter 6" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "wait_"
      ) ~
      "Explicit Table 6.05 green-card-wait comparison: 2005 → 2025",

    chapter == "Chapter 6" &
      stat_id %in%
        c(
          "h1b_denial_spike",
          "h1b_denial_recovery"
        ) ~
      "Observed H-1B denial-rate peak / recovery window",

    chapter == "Chapter 6" &
      stat_id ==
        "workforce_gap_us_vs_oecd" ~
      "2025 US vs OECD benchmark; not a time comparison",

    chapter == "Chapter 6" &
      (
        stat_id ==
          "trained_total" |
        stringr::str_starts(
          stat_id,
          "loss_"
        )
      ) ~
      "2012–14 doctorate cohort evaluated at the published ten-year stay rate",

    TRUE ~
      "First nonmissing observation → latest nonmissing observation"
  )
}


audit_years_expected <- function(
    chapter,
    stat_id
) {
  !(
    chapter == "Chapter 3" &
      stringr::str_starts(
        stat_id,
        "ai_staffing_"
      )
  ) &
    !(
      chapter == "Chapter 4" &
        stat_id %in%
          c(
            "pisa_us_vs_japan",
            "pisa_top_math_us_vs_oecd"
          )
    ) &
    !(
      chapter == "Chapter 4" &
        stringr::str_starts(
          stat_id,
          "spending_"
        )
    ) &
    !(
      chapter == "Chapter 6" &
        (
          stat_id ==
            "trained_total" |
          stringr::str_starts(
            stat_id,
            "loss_"
          )
        )
    )
}


audit_page_assignments <- function(
    data
) {
  pages <- paginate_infographic_data(
    data
  )

  total_pages <- length(
    pages
  )

  purrr::imap_dfr(
    pages,
    function(page, page_number) {
      contract <- infographic_page_contract(
        page,
        page_number = page_number,
        total_pages = total_pages
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        StatID = as.character(
          page$StatID
        ),
        Page = as.integer(
          page_number
        ),
        PageRow = seq_len(
          nrow(page)
        ),
        PageBodyRows =
          contract$body_rows,
        PageSectionHeaders =
          contract$section_headers,
        PageRenderedRows =
          contract$rendered_rows,
        PageIsFinal =
          contract$is_final
      )
    }
  )
}


audit_chapter <- function(
    data,
    chapter,
    source_map
) {
  page_map <- audit_page_assignments(
    data
  )

  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      AuditOrder =
        dplyr::row_number(),

      Source = unname(
        source_map[
          as.character(
            .data$StatID
          )
        ]
      ),

      EarlierYear =
        audit_extract_year(
          .data$Earlier
        ),

      LatestYear =
        audit_extract_year(
          .data$Latest
        ),

      EndpointRule =
        audit_endpoint_rule(
          chapter,
          as.character(
            .data$StatID
          )
        ),

      YearsExpected =
        audit_years_expected(
          chapter,
          as.character(
            .data$StatID
          )
        )
    ) %>%

    dplyr::left_join(
      page_map,
      by = "StatID"
    ) %>%

    dplyr::mutate(
      AuditFlag = dplyr::case_when(
        is.na(
          .data$Source
        ) ~
          "CHECK: source map missing",

        .data$YearsExpected &
          .data$Earlier !=
            "—" &
          is.na(
            .data$EarlierYear
          ) ~
          "CHECK: earlier cell has no year",

        .data$YearsExpected &
          .data$Latest !=
            "—" &
          is.na(
            .data$LatestYear
          ) ~
          "CHECK: latest cell has no year",

        !is.na(
          .data$EarlierYear
        ) &
          !is.na(
            .data$LatestYear
          ) &
          as.integer(
            .data$EarlierYear
          ) >
            as.integer(
              .data$LatestYear
            ) ~
          "CHECK: earlier year is later than latest year",

        .data$PageBodyRows >
          INFOGRAPHIC_ROWS_PER_PAGE ~
          "CHECK: page exceeds body-row cap",

        .data$PageSectionHeaders >
          INFOGRAPHIC_SECTION_HEADERS_PER_PAGE ~
          "CHECK: page exceeds section-header cap",

        .data$PageRenderedRows >
          INFOGRAPHIC_RENDERED_ROWS_PER_PAGE ~
          "CHECK: page exceeds rendered-row budget",

        !.data$PageIsFinal &
          .data$PageBodyRows !=
            INFOGRAPHIC_ROWS_PER_PAGE ~
          "CHECK: nonfinal page is not 30 body rows",

        !.data$PageIsFinal &
          .data$PageSectionHeaders !=
            INFOGRAPHIC_SECTION_HEADERS_PER_PAGE ~
          "CHECK: nonfinal page is not 5 section headers",

        TRUE ~
          ""
      )
    ) %>%

    dplyr::transmute(
      Chapter = chapter,
      Page = .data$Page,
      PageRow = .data$PageRow,
      PageBodyRows =
        .data$PageBodyRows,
      PageSectionHeaders =
        .data$PageSectionHeaders,
      PageRenderedRows =
        .data$PageRenderedRows,
      StatID = as.character(
        .data$StatID
      ),
      Section = as.character(
        .data$Section
      ),
      Measure = as.character(
        .data$Measure
      ),
      Source = .data$Source,
      EarlierYear =
        .data$EarlierYear,
      LatestYear =
        .data$LatestYear,
      Earlier = as.character(
        .data$Earlier
      ),
      Latest = as.character(
        .data$Latest
      ),
      Change = as.character(
        .data$Change
      ),
      EndpointRule =
        .data$EndpointRule,
      AuditFlag =
        .data$AuditFlag,
      AuditOrder =
        .data$AuditOrder
    )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CHAPTER_EXPORT_NAMES <- c(
  "Chapter 1" =
    "infographic_ch1_by_the_numbers",
  "Chapter 2" =
    "infographic_ch2_by_the_numbers",
  "Chapter 3" =
    "infographic_ch3_by_the_numbers",
  "Chapter 4" =
    "infographic_ch4_by_the_numbers",
  "Chapter 5" =
    "infographic_ch5_by_the_numbers",
  "Chapter 6" =
    "infographic_ch6_by_the_numbers"
)


infographic_page_layout_audit <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  CHAPTER_EXPORT_NAMES,
  function(export_name, chapter) {
    if (
      !exists(
        export_name,
        envir = INFOGRAPHIC_EXPORT_REGISTRY,
        inherits = FALSE
      )
    ) {
      return(
        tibble::tibble(
          Chapter = chapter,
          Name = export_name,
          Page = NA_integer_,
          TotalPages = NA_integer_,
          BodyRows = NA_integer_,
          SectionHeaders = NA_integer_,
          RenderedRows = NA_integer_,
          IsFinalPage = NA,
          WidthIn = INFOGRAPHIC_SPEC$width_in,
          HeightIn = INFOGRAPHIC_SPEC$height_in,
          ExpectedWidthPx =
            INFOGRAPHIC_SPEC$output_width_px,
          ExpectedHeightPx =
            INFOGRAPHIC_SPEC$output_height_px,
          ActualWidthPx = NA_integer_,
          ActualHeightPx = NA_integer_,
          DimensionVerification =
            "CHECK: export not registered",
          PNG = NA_character_
        )
      )
    }

    get(
      export_name,
      envir = INFOGRAPHIC_EXPORT_REGISTRY,
      inherits = FALSE
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Chapter = chapter,
        .before = 1
      )
  }
) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(
    LayoutFlag = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(
        .data$Page
      ) ~
        "CHECK: chapter export not registered",

      .data$BodyRows >
        INFOGRAPHIC_ROWS_PER_PAGE ~
        "CHECK: body-row cap exceeded",

      .data$SectionHeaders >
        INFOGRAPHIC_SECTION_HEADERS_PER_PAGE ~
        "CHECK: section-header cap exceeded",

      .data$RenderedRows >
        INFOGRAPHIC_RENDERED_ROWS_PER_PAGE ~
        "CHECK: rendered-row budget exceeded",

      !.data$IsFinalPage &
        .data$BodyRows !=
          INFOGRAPHIC_ROWS_PER_PAGE ~
        "CHECK: nonfinal page is not 30 body rows",

      !.data$IsFinalPage &
        .data$SectionHeaders !=
          INFOGRAPHIC_SECTION_HEADERS_PER_PAGE ~
        "CHECK: nonfinal page is not 5 section headers",

      is.finite(
        .data$ActualWidthPx
      ) &
        .data$ActualWidthPx !=
          .data$ExpectedWidthPx ~
        "CHECK: PNG width differs from publication spec",

      is.finite(
        .data$ActualHeightPx
      ) &
        .data$ActualHeightPx !=
          .data$ExpectedHeightPx ~
        "CHECK: PNG height differs from publication spec",

      TRUE ~
        ""
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::arrange(
    factor(
      .data$Chapter,
      levels = paste0(
        "Chapter ",
        1:6
      )
    ),
    .data$Page
  )

    infographic_source_year_audit$AuditFlag
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

layout_problem_count <- sum(
  nzchar(
    infographic_page_layout_audit$LayoutFlag
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


message(
  "Infographic source/year audit saved to: ",
  INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_PATH,
  ". Flags requiring review: ",
  source_year_problem_count,
  "."
)

message(
  "Infographic page-layout audit saved to: ",
  INFOGRAPHIC_LAYOUT_AUDIT_PATH,
  ". Flags requiring review: ",
  layout_problem_count,
  "."
)


if (
  source_year_problem_count > 0L ||
  layout_problem_count > 0L
) {
  warning(
    "Infographic QA completed with ",
    source_year_problem_count,
    " source/year flag(s) and ",
    layout_problem_count,
    " layout flag(s). Review the audit CSVs before publication.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}


if (
  isTRUE(
    INFOGRAPHIC_AUDIT_SHOW
  )
) {
  cat(
    "\n\n## Infographic source/year audit\n\n"
  )

  print(
    knitr::kable(
      infographic_source_year_audit %>%
        dplyr::select(
          Chapter,
          Page,
          PageRow,
          StatID,
          Measure,
          Source,
          EarlierYear,
          LatestYear,
          AuditFlag
        ),
      align = c(
        "l",
        "c",
        "c",
        "l",
        "l",
        "l",
        "c",
        "c",
        "l"
      )
    )
  )

  cat(
    "\n\n## Infographic page-layout audit\n\n"
  )

  print(
    knitr::kable(
      infographic_page_layout_audit %>%
        dplyr::select(
          Chapter,
          Page,
          BodyRows,
          SectionHeaders,
          RenderedRows,
          WidthIn,
          HeightIn,
          ActualWidthPx,
          ActualHeightPx,
          LayoutFlag
        ),
      align = c(
        "l",
        "c",
        "c",
        "c",
        "c",
        "c",
        "c",
        "c",
        "c",
        "l"
      )
    )
  )
}
```
